mapper.sql: SELECT L.CONTRACT_NO, L.INSR_CLS_CD, L.PRD_CD, V.CVRG_CD, V.PREM, (L.END_DATE - L.START_DATE) AS TERM_DAYS, GREATEST(0, LEAST(L.END_DATE, COALESCE(L.TERM_DT, L.END_DATE), #{toExcl}) - GREATEST(L.START_DATE, #{fromDate})) AS EXPOSED_DAYS FROM TB_CTR_LGD L JOIN TB_CTR_CVRG V ON V.CONTRACT_NO = L.CONTRACT_NO WHERE L.CTR_STAT_CD IN ('20', '30')

SELECT L.INSR_CLS_CD, L.PRD_CD, I.CVRG_CD, C.CLM_NO, CASE WHEN C.CLM_STAT_CD = '40' THEN I.PAY_AMT ELSE 0 END AS PAID, CASE WHEN C.CLM_STAT_CD = '20' THEN I.PAY_AMT WHEN C.CLM_STAT_CD = '10' THEN I.CLAIM_AMT ELSE 0 END AS OUTSTANDING FROM TB_CLM C JOIN TB_CLM_CVRG I ON I.CLM_NO = C.CLM_NO JOIN TB_CTR_LGD L ON L.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO WHERE C.CLM_STAT_CD IN ('10', '20', '40') AND C.ACDT_DT >= #{fromDate} AND C.ACDT_DT < #{toExcl}
INSR_CLS_CDCAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS INSR_CLS_CD, PRD_CDCAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS PRD_CD, CVRG_CDCAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS CVRG_CD,
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONTRACT_NO) AS CNT, COALESCE(SUM(PREM * EXPOSED_DAYS / NULLIF(TERM_DAYS, 0)), 0) AS EARNED FROM () E WHERE EXPOSED_DAYS > 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CLM_NO) AS CNT, COALESCE(SUM(PAID), 0) AS PAID, COALESCE(SUM(OUTSTANDING), 0) AS OUTSTANDING FROM () X
SELECT CVRG_CD, CVRG_NM, ANNUAL_RATE FROM TB_PRM_RATE WHERE INSR_CLS_CD = #{insrClsCd} AND EFF_FROM <= #{today} AND (EFF_TO IS NULL OR EFF_TO >= #{today}) ORDER BY CVRG_CD

SELECT 'RATE' AS KIND, CVRG_CD AS TARGET, EFF_FROM FROM TB_PRM_RATE WHERE INSR_CLS_CD = #{insrClsCd} AND (EFF_FROM > #{fromDate} AND EFF_FROM <= #{toDate} OR EFF_FROM > #{today}) UNION ALL SELECT 'FACTOR', FACTOR_TYPE, EFF_FROM FROM TB_PRM_FACTOR WHERE INSR_CLS_CD = #{insrClsCd} AND (EFF_FROM > #{fromDate} AND EFF_FROM <= #{toDate} OR EFF_FROM > #{today}) ORDER BY 3, 1, 2

SELECT V.CVRG_CDCAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS CVRG_CD, COUNT(DISTINCT L.CONTRACT_NO) AS CNT, COALESCE(SUM(V.PREM), 0) AS PREM, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN L.END_DATE <= #{renewTo} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CTR_LGD R WHERE R.RENEWED_FROM = L.CONTRACT_NO AND R.CTR_STAT_CD <> '90') THEN L.CONTRACT_NO END) AS RCNT, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN L.END_DATE <= #{renewTo} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CTR_LGD R WHERE R.RENEWED_FROM = L.CONTRACT_NO AND R.CTR_STAT_CD <> '90') THEN V.PREM ELSE 0 END), 0) AS RPREM FROM TB_CTR_LGD L JOIN TB_CTR_CVRG V ON V.CONTRACT_NO = L.CONTRACT_NO WHERE L.CTR_STAT_CD = '20' AND L.INSR_CLS_CD = #{insrClsCd} AND L.START_DATE <= #{today} AND L.END_DATE > #{today} GROUP BY V.CVRG_CD

SELECT C.ACDT_DT, CAST(C.DECIDE_DT AS DATE) AS PAID_DT, C.TOTAL_PAY_AMT FROM TB_CLM C JOIN TB_CTR_LGD L ON L.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO WHERE L.INSR_CLS_CD = #{insrClsCd} AND C.CLM_STAT_CD = '40' AND C.TOTAL_PAY_AMT > 0 AND C.ACDT_DT >= #{from} AND C.ACDT_DT <= #{eval} AND C.DECIDE_DT < #{evalExcl}

SELECT C.ACDT_DT, CASE WHEN C.ADJ_DT < #{evalExcl} AND C.TOTAL_PAY_AMT IS NOT NULL AND C.CLM_STAT_CD IN ('20', '40') THEN C.TOTAL_PAY_AMT ELSE C.TOTAL_CLAIM_AMT END AS RSV FROM TB_CLM C JOIN TB_CTR_LGD L ON L.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO WHERE L.INSR_CLS_CD = #{insrClsCd} AND C.ACDT_DT >= #{from} AND C.ACDT_DT <= #{eval} AND C.RPT_DT < #{evalExcl} AND (C.DECIDE_DT IS NULL OR C.DECIDE_DT >= #{evalExcl})
